reasoning_content: Now let's set up the monorepo build orchestration with pnpm.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Update root package.json with proper monorepo scripts
root_pkg = '''{
  "name": "@arelororian/monorepo",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "pnpm -r build",
    "build:network": "pnpm -r --filter @arelorian/core-network build",
    "build:2d": "pnpm -r --filter @arelorian/client-2d build",
    "build:3d": "pnpm -r --filter @wasd/client build",
    "dev:network": "pnpm -r --filter @arelorian/core-network dev",
    "dev:2d": "pnpm -r --filter @arelorian/client-2d dev",
    "dev:3d": "pnpm -r --filter @wasd/client dev",
    "dev:all": "concurrently \\"pnpm dev:network\\" \\"pnpm dev:2d\\" \\"pnpm dev:3d\\"",
    "build:all": "pnpm build:network && pnpm build:2d && pnpm build:3d",
    "install": "pnpm install -r",
    "clean": "pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist node_modules"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=18",
    "pnpm": ">=8"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "concurrently": "^8.2.2"
  }
}
'''

sftp = c.open_sftp()
with sftp.file('/tmp/package.json', 'w') as f:
    f.write(root_pkg)

c.exec_command('cp /tmp/package.json /opt/areloria/package.json')

print("✅ Root package.json updated with monorepo scripts!")

# List structure
c.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/")
c.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/packages/")
c.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/apps/")

c.close()
EOF
